basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old gamer living in California, passionate about strategy games and esports. I've been playing League of Legends for about 5 years, with Elise as my main champion. When I'm not gaming, I work as a freelance graphic designer. I'm a night owl, often online during late nights or early mornings. I'm single and enjoy discussing gaming strategies with friends and fellow players. Besides gaming, I love attending music festivals and exploring new tech gadgets.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in gaming, especially in MOBA games like League of Legends, comes from years of dedicated play and self-teaching. I've watched countless tutorials and streams to improve my skills. I also occasionally explore automotive and stock trading topics, as I find them intriguing.
